in_latin.name: Benedetto
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Benedicti, meaning 'benedictus', or 'blessed'. Origines a Benedictus, a Latin word meaning 'blessed' or 'happy'. Historically, the name Benedictus was given to children born during times of peace and prosperity. In the early Christian Church, the name Benedictus was associated with Saint Benedict of Nursia, who founded the Benedictine Order. Today, the name Benedetto is still used in many Christian cultures, symbolizing blessings and happiness.

Today, the name Benedetto is still used in many Christian cultures, symbolizing blessings and happiness.
